title: Harvest sparkle
steps: Make the cider syrup in a small saucepan over medium heat. Mix the honey, freshly squeezed orange juice, ground ginger, cinnamon, and ground cloves. Whisk until it starts to bubble. Remove from heat for 5 minutes. If cider syrup is already available, skip this step.
Mix the whiskey and 1/4 of the cider syrup over ice in a shaker.
Add the sparkling wine and garnish.
